title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
synopsis: The adventure is over, but an elf mage's journey is just beginning. Frieren sets out to understand the fleeting lives of the friends who changed hers.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
synopsis: Two brothers search for the Philosopher's Stone after an alchemy experiment costs them more than they imagined. Their journey reveals a conspiracy that spans an entire nation.

title: Steins;Gate
synopsis: A self-proclaimed mad scientist and his friends discover a way to send messages into the past. Each small change puts their future further out of reach.

title: Hunter x Hunter
synopsis: Gon leaves his island home to become a Hunter and find his father. The people he meets and the challenges he faces make the journey far bigger than he expected.

title: Cowboy Bebop
synopsis: A mismatched crew of bounty hunters drifts through the solar system, chasing their next payday while trying to outrun their pasts. A space western with a jazz heartbeat.

title: Violet Evergarden
synopsis: After the war, a young former soldier becomes a letter writer. Giving voice to other people's feelings slowly helps her understand her own.

title: Spirited Away
synopsis: When her family stumbles into a world of spirits, Chihiro must find courage, friendship, and a way home while working in a mysterious bathhouse.

title: Your Name.
synopsis: Two teenagers living far apart begin waking up in each other's bodies. A connection that starts with confusion becomes a search across distance and time.

title: Demon Slayer
synopsis: After his family is attacked, Tanjiro joins the Demon Slayer Corps to protect others and find a way to turn his sister back into a human.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen
synopsis: Yuji Itadori enters a hidden world of curses after swallowing a dangerous relic. At a school for sorcerers, he learns that saving people rarely comes without a cost.

title: Attack on Titan
synopsis: Humanity lives behind enormous walls to escape the Titans outside. When the walls are breached, three friends join a struggle that changes their understanding of the world.

title: Death Note
synopsis: A brilliant student finds a notebook that can kill anyone whose name is written inside. His attempt to reshape the world sparks a battle of wits with an elusive detective.

title: Spy x Family
synopsis: A spy builds a pretend family for his latest mission, unaware that his new wife is an assassin and his adopted daughter can read minds.

title: Bocchi the Rock!
synopsis: A shy guitarist dreams of making friends through music. Joining a small rock band pushes her out of her bedroom and into the wonderfully awkward world of live performance.

title: Vinland Saga
synopsis: A young warrior follows the mercenary who killed his father. Against the backdrop of a Viking invasion, his quest for revenge challenges what it means to be a true warrior.

title: Mob Psycho 100
synopsis: A quiet teenager with extraordinary psychic powers wants an ordinary life. His work with a self-proclaimed spiritual expert turns every strange encounter into a chance to grow.

title: Chainsaw Man
synopsis: Denji's simple dreams collide with a brutal world of devils when he gains the power to transform parts of his body into chainsaws.

title: One Punch Man
synopsis: Saitama has become so powerful that every fight ends with one punch. While he searches for a challenge, the world struggles to recognize its most unlikely hero.

title: A Silent Voice
synopsis: A former bully seeks out the deaf classmate he hurt years ago. An attempt to make amends becomes a story about guilt, friendship, and learning to listen.

title: Made in Abyss
synopsis: An aspiring cave raider and a robot boy descend into an enormous chasm in search of answers. The wonders they discover are matched by the dangers of the journey back.
